item.title: 2025 in review: UK fiber market still pending consolidation
item.description: This year has seen Openreach and VMO2 fixed customer bases shrink, but altnets are still struggling in a UK market that seems over-ripe for consolidation.

item.title: 2025 in review: Asia emerges as the hub of the data center boom
item.description: Multibillion-dollar investments in data centers made their way to the Asia-Pacific region in 2025.

item.title: Eurobites: VodafoneThree brings 400 call center jobs back to UK
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: UK government consults on planning reform proposals; Ericsson deploys massive MIMO for NTT Docomo; Telefónica blows its own IoT trumpet.

item.title: Verizon slices some 5G spectrum for enterprise-class FWA
item.description: Verizon is promising to deliver faster speeds and enable service-level agreements via a new '5G Network Slice – Enhanced Internet' product targeted to large business customers.

item.title: AOI's new laser targets data centers and AI
item.description: AOI has launched a new 400-milliwatt laser designed to meet the demand for AI in data centers. #pressrelease

item.title: EdgeBeam takes hybrid network approach with ATSC 3.0/4G combo
item.description: Now in the ramp-up stage, broadcaster-backed datacasting company EdgeBeam has landed its first customer as it builds out a national hybrid network powered by ATSC 3.0 and 4G.

item.title: David Henry named CEO of Boundless Devices
item.description: Boundless Devices, a company that makes Motorola-branded home networking products, has appointed David Henry as CEO. Henry most recently ran Netgear's consumer division. #pressrelease

item.title: Data center capex up 59% on continued AI investment in 3Q 2025 – Dell'Oro
item.description: Accelerated server demand and hyperscale cloud expansion drive broad-based infrastructure spending. #pressrelease

item.title: Hughes releases transportable terminals in ruggedized case for rapid connectivity
item.description: Portable terminals enable plug-and-play setup for disaster response, remote operations and business continuity. #pressrelease

item.title: 'Broadband switchers' are tech savvy, will pay for premium experiences – study
item.description: A Calix-commissioned study identified that 'broadband switchers' tend to be heavy users of applications and connect a lot of devices, are willing to pay for personalized packages and expect 'modern' customer support. #pressrelease
